decks.notes: This aggro deck focuses on quickly building up a board presence with aggressive creatures and using powerful spells to disrupt the opponent's game plan. The deck includes a mix of efficient threats like Marauding Mako and Vivi Ornitier, as well as disruptive spells like Torch the Tower and Lightning Axe. With a mix of card advantage from cards like Proft's Eidetic Memory and powerful finishers like Jadzi, Steward of Fate, this deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a combination of speed and versatility.

The main focus of the deck is to quickly fill up the graveyard with instants and sorceries to bring back Arclight Phoenix from the graveyard and deal massive damage to the opponent. The deck also includes card draw and selection spells to ensure consistent access to the key cards needed to execute this game plan. Aggression, graveyard synergy, and efficient card selection are all crucial aspects of this deck.

The main concept of this Izzet Control deck is to maintain control of the game through a combination of counterspells, bounce spells, and card draw. By utilizing cards like Divide by Zero, Spell Pierce, and Combustion Technique, the deck aims to disrupt the opponent's strategy while building card advantage through spells like Accumulate Wisdom and Stormchaser's Talent. The inclusion of powerful planeswalkers like Ral, Crackling Wit and Vivi Ornitier adds additional versatility and threat to the deck, allowing for various win conditions. The mana base is carefully constructed to support the deck's color requirements and maintain consistency throughout the game.

This deck focuses on employing removal spells and hand disruption to control the game while gradually building advantage through card advantage and graveyard recursion. It utilizes powerful threats like Sheoldred, the Apocalypse and Emeritus of Abundance to close out games. The deck's mana base supports these strategies while also providing options for color fixing and utility lands. The main goal is to disrupt the opponent's game plan while establishing a board presence that is difficult to deal with, ultimately out-valuing and outlasting the opponent to secure victory.

The deck focuses on gaining control of the game by utilizing a combination of counterspells, hand disruption, and removal spells. It aims to disrupt the opponent's strategy while steadily building card advantage and controlling the board. Yorion, Sky Nomad is included as a companion to provide additional value through blinking permanents for extra card advantage. The deck also includes a variety of dual lands to ensure consistent mana production for both blue and black spells. Overall, the key concept is to dominate the game through control and resource management.

The deck focuses on assembling a powerful combo involving Greasefang, Okiba Boss and Parhelion II to control the board and overwhelm the opponent. By utilizing cards like Bitter Triumph, Thoughtseize, Cache Grab, and Formidable Speaker to disrupt the opponent's strategy, the deck aims to protect its key pieces while generating value with cards like Temple Garden, Esika's Chariot, and Multiversal Passage. The inclusion of Boseiju, Who Endures and other mana-fixing lands ensures consistency in casting the combo pieces. Overall, the deck emphasizes synergy between its cards to create a winning strategy.

The deck focuses on assembling the Greasefang Parhelion combo by utilizing cards like Cache Grab and Thoughtseize to search for key pieces. It also includes cards like Bitter Triumph and Temple Garden to control the board and protect the combo. The deck features a mix of creatures like Greasefang, Okiba Boss and spells like Collective Brutality to disrupt the opponent's strategy. The inclusion of cards like Parhelion II and Thundering Broodwagon provide additional win conditions and versatility to the deck's strategy. Overall, the deck aims to quickly assemble its combo pieces and overwhelm the opponent with powerful threats.

This deck focuses on a fast and aggressive playstyle, utilizing cheap spells and creatures to quickly deal damage to the opponent. The key strategy is to maintain a high tempo by casting spells like Burst Lightning and Boomerang Basics to control the board and protect your creatures. Monastery Swiftspear and Soul-Scar Mage are key creatures that benefit from casting multiple spells in a single turn. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a combination of direct damage spells and aggressive creatures, making it difficult for them to stabilize and gain control of the game.

This deck focuses on using Greasefang Parhelion in combination with various support cards to create a powerful combo. The deck includes protection spells, removal spells, and creatures to help set up and protect the combo. With the ability to generate token creatures and make use of sacrifice effects, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a combination of aggressive creatures and powerful abilities. It also includes cards that provide card advantage and disruption to control the pace of the game.

The main focus of this deck is to control the game with a combination of counter spells, card draw, and removal, while also generating value through card advantage and efficient threats. The deck uses a mix of targeted removal like Combustion Technique and It'll Quench Ya!, along with sweepers like Firebending Lesson. The deck also aims to generate card advantage through spells like Pop Quiz and Accumulate Wisdom, as well as card selection with Tablet of Discovery. The win condition of the deck lies in resolving powerful threats like Thor, God of Thunder and utilizing them to close out the game.

The main idea of this Izzet Control deck is to efficiently control the opponent's board through a combination of counter spells, removal spells, and card draw. By utilizing a mix of instant speed spells and cheap counters like Divide by Zero and Spell Pierce, combined with efficient threats like Stormchaser's Talent and Ral, Crackling Wit, the deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan while steadily drawing into more resources. The key is to maintain control of the game by carefully managing resources and responding to threats appropriately.

The deck focuses on disrupting the opponent's strategy through a combination of hand disruption spells like Thoughtseize and removal spells like Fatal Push. It also aims to control the board with cards like Abrupt Decay and Sheoldred, the Apocalypse. The deck has a solid mana base with lands like Mutavault and Overgrown Tomb. It also has some recursion with Emeritus of Abundance and ways to generate value with cards like Unholy Annex. Overall, the deck aims to control the game and outvalue the opponent with a combination of removal, disruption, and card advantage.

The focal point of this deck is to create a fast-paced aggressive strategy that utilizes Azorius tempo elements and Spirit creatures to overwhelm opponents quickly. By utilizing cards like Curious Obsession, Geistlight Snare, and Supreme Phantom, the deck aims to control the tempo of the game and maintain a steady flow of aggression. With a mix of evasion, disruption, and card advantage, this deck looks to outmaneuver opponents and secure victory through a combination of efficient creatures and powerful spells. The inclusion of cards like Spell Queller and Spectral Sailor further strengthens the deck's control aspect.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly establish board presence and disrupt the opponent's game plan by using a combination of cheap spells and aggressive creatures. By utilizing efficient creatures like Monastery Swiftspear and Soul-Scar Mage alongside burn spells like Burst Lightning and Reckless Rage, the deck aims to apply constant pressure on the opponent while clearing their threats. The inclusion of card draw spells like Sleight of Hand and Stormchaser's Talent allows for consistency in drawing into key pieces while maintaining a fast pace. By maximizing tempo and aggression, this deck aims to overwhelm opponents and secure a quick victory.

This deck focuses on assembling the Greasefang Parhelion combo, using cards like Grisly Salvage, Esika's Chariot, and Formidable Speaker to find the necessary pieces. The goal is to generate a large amount of mana and play Parhelion II while having Greasefang, Okiba Boss on the battlefield to create a powerful flying token army. Thundering Broodwagon and Professor of Symbology provide additional support and card advantage to help execute the combo efficiently. Overall, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a massive flying army and clinch the victory.

The main focus of this deck is to have a fast-paced, aggressive playstyle using a combination of Azorius tempo and Spirit creatures. By utilizing cards like Essence Flux and Daydream, along with mana ramp from Mox Amber and Springleaf Drum, the deck aims to overwhelm opponents with a quick and efficient strategy. The inclusion of powerful Spirit creatures like Haliya, Starfield Shepherd, and Quantum Riddler further enhances the aggro potential of the deck, while providing support with abilities like card draw and protection. Overall, the key concept of this deck is to maintain tempo and pressure while utilizing a synergistic mix of Azorius and Spirit cards.
